LESSON: SQUARES AND SQUARE ROOTS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Squares and Square Roots
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Squares and Square Roots, part of Numbers in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we apply squares and square roots in daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals squares of numbers using: ✔ Grids and charts learners with manipulation difficulties could use enlarged grids and charts. ✔ Long multiplication method more time could be allowed for learners with manipulation difficulties. ✔ Using calculators/adapted calculator. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use any functional part of the body to perform the tasks.

2. Work out square roots of number in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals using: ✔Factors method 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Work out in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals squares of numbers using: ✔ Grids and charts learners with manipulation difficulties could use enlarged grids and charts. ✔ Long multiplication method more time could be allowed for learners with manipulation difficulties. ✔ Using calculators/adapted calculator. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use any functional part of the body to perform the tasks.
2. Work out square roots of number in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals using: ✔Factors method 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Squares and Square Roots together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: Reflection as the learner uses grid squares and charts to find squares and square roots

of numbers.

● Digital literacy: Interacting with technologies as the learner uses IT devices to work out squares and square roots of

numbers.

Values

● Respect: as the learner appreciates each other’s contribution in using grids and charts

● Unity: as the learner shares and works out the factors of numbers to get the square roots of numbers.
